Scalar T=lambda I instead forces lambda(lambda-1)=0, and both allowed cases have a rank-one projector witness. This proves exact iff for all characteristics. The exceptional parametrization, rank-one determinantal closure, codimension and Segre degree then follow directly; finite-field count uses |GL2(q)|. value.rationale: The initiating algebraic-geometry paper expressly separates Zariski closure from exact parameter attainment and leaves the latter as an open calculation. The architecture (2,3,2) with all three block sizes one is the smallest nonclosed example under its general closedness criterion. A complete, uniform missing-locus classification identifies exactly where the defining equations fail to certify a realizable pair; it exhibits the codimension-three determinantal geometry of that failure and gives exact rational point counts over every finite field. This is a natural complete invariant of the motivating object, not a cherry-picked numerical case.
